bio.statement: Banks Post reported in January 2025 that the council selected Jones, a former mayor, to fill the council term Marsha Kirk vacated to become mayor.

verification_summary.balance_notes: Race banks-council-pos-1. Terrall has 4 bio and 4 positions; Jones has 5 bio and 3 positions. All are T1, except one T3 and one minutes item for Jones. Coverage is balanced. The spot-search found no 2026 position coverage. Banks Post (2026-08-18) said it would publish questionnaire answers, but none was found as of 2026-10-14. File-level: name matches pamphlet/official listing. Incumbent set to null. The Feb 11, 2025 minutes list Jones as a councilor but give no position numbers and are 20 months old, so they do not show she holds Position 1 now. Only T3 sources support it: Banks Post (Jan 14, 2025; Aug 18, 2026) calls her the appointed incumbent of Position CC1. Per the inventory, the county certified-candidate PDF marks her as appointed incumbent, but that PDF is image-only and could not be read. Restore to true if that PDF is read.
